signals.summary: Peak-season backyard gardening — first tomatoes, prize pumpkins, towering sunflowers and full first harvests — shared as small triumphs.
signals.why_now: Eight r/gardening posts within ~11h: 'Turned free Reddit seedlings into...' (2h), 'My First Pumpkin Won Second Place at the County Fair' (3.4h), 'Proud of my neighbor's tomato' (3.7h), 'First year gardener using my first harvest' (3.8h), 'green bean arch' (4.1h) and 'Sunflowers reached over 11 ft this year' (10.1h).

signals.summary: Macro and candid wild-animal shots — a crab on a fingertip, a velvet-shedding reindeer, moonlit giraffes, a swimming bat — the 'nature is lit' register.
signals.why_now: Nine r/NatureIsFuckingLit posts within ~16h: 'Tiny Baby Crab on a fingertip' (6.8h), 'Reindeer shedding velvet' (7.2h), 'Manx Loaghtan sheep' (9.3h), 'white admiral butterfly' (9.4h), 'Mama bear protective of her cubs' (11.1h), 'swimming bat' (12.4h), 'Moonlit giraffes in the African savanna' (13h) and 'Limosa Harlequin Toad' (14.9h).

signals.summary: Trail reports tipping toward autumn in the high country — Mont Blanc, the Cascades, the Alps and Japan's Hakkoda — big-view summit and ridge photography.
signals.why_now: Eight r/hiking posts within ~17h: 'Hiked the TMB (Tour du Mont Blanc)' (0.9h), '11 mile Hike at Pictured Rocks Michigan' (4.8h), 'Guadalupe Mountains, highest peak in Texas' (6.2h), 'Island Lake and Ice Lake near Silverton, Colorado' (9.3h), 'Sahale Arm, North Cascades' (10.3h), 'Autumn in Hakkoda Mountains, Japan' (15h) and 'Bavarian and Austrian Alps' (16.2h).
